ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white base pixels with high-contrast low-intensity black pigmentation covering approximately 25-30% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark pigmentation concentrated at the fluke-to-peduncle junction and trailing margins; irregular dark mottling and focal clusters distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel-based interior angle of 55-65 degrees and significant depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern characterized by high-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire visible trailing boundary; asymmetrical jaggedness with deeper macro-notches on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to acute distal points; trailing edges exhibit an overall irregular convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete dark circular pixel clusters localized on the mid-sections of both lobes, particularly visible against the high-intensity white background.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the medial surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and significant jagged tissue loss along the distal trailing edges of both lobes, exceeding typical serration frequency.
